description: A pharmacy has 3000 mg of morphine to make painkillers and sleeping pills. Each painkiller pill requires 10 mg of morphine and 3 units of digestive medicine. Each sleeping pill requires 6 mg of morphine and 5 units of digestive medicine. The pharmacy needs to make at least 50 painkiller pills. Since sleeping pills are more popular, at least 70% of the pills should be sleeping pills. How many of each should the pharmacy make to minimize the total amount of digestive medicine needed?

MorphinePerPainkiller.definition: Amount of morphine required for one painkiller pill

MorphinePerSleepingPill.definition: Amount of morphine required for one sleeping pill

DigestiveMedicinePerPainkiller.definition: Amount of digestive medicine required for one painkiller pill

DigestiveMedicinePerSleepingPill.definition: Amount of digestive medicine required for one sleeping pill

MinPainkillerPills.definition: Minimum number of painkiller pills to be produced

MinSleepingPillsProportion.definition: Minimum proportion of pills that should be sleeping pills

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of digestive medicine used in producing painkiller and sleeping pills"
objective.code:
model.setObjective(
    DigestiveMedicinePerPainkiller * PainkillerPills +
    DigestiveMedicinePerSleepingPill * SleepingPills,
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

constraints.description: 10 times the number of painkiller pills plus 6 times the number of sleeping pills should not exceed the total available morphine
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    MorphinePerPainkiller * PainkillerPills + 
    MorphinePerSleepingPill * SleepingPills 
    <= TotalMorphine
)

constraints.description: The number of painkiller pills produced should be at least the minimum required painkiller pills
The number of sleeping pills should be at least 70% of the total number of pills produced

PainkillerPills.definition: Number of painkiller pills to be produced

SleepingPills.definition: Number of sleeping pills to be produced
